Before you use this page

Is any of this real customer data?

No. The page describes GoRun's own section library. Replace every sentence with your own before publishing.

Where do the background patterns come from?

From the identity settings of the active theme. A section with the gp-s-bg class uses the site default; a modifier such as gp-s-bg-grid picks its own.

Does it work without JavaScript?

Yes. Every block here is CSS only, including the icons, the arrows and the drawn interface.

What about reduced motion?

Hover lifts and the FAQ marker rotation are disabled when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
